statements.impact_statement: Trivy 0.67.2 reports no vulnerable FastMCP in this image; the runtime carries fastmcp and fastmcp-slim 3.4.11, above the 3.4.10 fixed release that the previous candidate image reported as 3.4.4.
statements.action_statement: Reassess if the locked FastMCP dependency changes or if the image is rebuilt from a different source revision. This statement is a technical assessment, not a waiver and not an operator approval.

statements.impact_statement: Trivy 0.67.2 reports no vulnerable opentelemetry-api in this image; the runtime carries opentelemetry-api 1.45.1, the fixed version that the previous candidate image reported as 1.44.0.
statements.action_statement: Reassess if the locked opentelemetry-api dependency changes or if the image is rebuilt from a different source revision. This statement is a technical assessment, not a waiver and not an operator approval.
